assessments.title: A0 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all Starter lessons to find anything the learner missed and confirm whether they are ready to begin A1.

assessments.title: A1 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all A1 lessons to identify anything the learner missed and confirm whether they are ready to begin A2.

assessments.title: A2 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all A2 lessons to identify anything the learner missed and confirm whether they are ready to begin B1.

assessments.title: B1 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all B1 lessons to identify any remaining gaps and confirm whether the learner is ready to begin B2.

assessments.title: B2 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all B2 lessons to identify any remaining gaps and confirm readiness for advanced independent English work.

assessments.title: C1 End-of-Level Diagnostic
assessments.description: Use this after all C1 lessons to confirm precise, flexible, and sustained advanced English across demanding contexts.

assessments.description: A short check that gives a rough placement from Pre-A1 to B2. It is not a full CEFR exam. Complete the language questions, then use the speaking sample to confirm the result.
